top_risks.title: AI-driven job cuts
evidence: Meta Plans 8,000 Job Cuts in May
Stanford’s AI Index finds China has nearly closed the performance gap with the US
top_risks.causal_chain: Advancements in AI lead to increased automation, resulting in job displacement.
top_risks.recommended_action: Invest in retraining and upskilling programs for workers at risk of displacement.

top_risks.title: Outdated skills due to AI
evidence: Stanford’s AI Index finds China has nearly closed the performance gap with the US
top_risks.causal_chain: Rapid advancements in AI lead to outdated skills, making workers less competitive.
top_risks.recommended_action: Encourage continuous learning and professional development to stay up-to-date with AI-driven changes.

top_risks.title: AI-driven wage stagnation
evidence: Stanford’s AI Index finds China has nearly closed the performance gap with the US
top_risks.causal_chain: Increased automation due to AI leads to wage stagnation as workers are replaced or see reduced hours.
top_risks.recommended_action: Monitor wage trends and consider implementing policies to mitigate wage suppression.

top_risks.title: AI-driven hiring slowdown
evidence: Meta Plans 8,000 Job Cuts in May
top_risks.causal_chain: Economic uncertainty and AI-driven job displacement lead to a hiring slowdown.
top_risks.recommended_action: Encourage companies to invest in AI-driven hiring tools to streamline the hiring process.

top_risks.title: IRS workforce reduction
evidence: IRS Enforcement Takes Another Big Hit As Budget Request Shrinks
top_risks.causal_chain: Budget cuts lead to workforce reduction, potentially impacting public services.
top_risks.recommended_action: Invest in retraining and upskilling programs for public sector workers at risk of displacement.

soft_risks.title: Outdated regulations

soft_risks.title: Education pipeline mismatch
